long_biography.plain_text:
Turning locally developed television formats into international franchises established Reinout Oerlemans as a Dutch media entrepreneur. He had first become known as an actor in Goede Tijden, Slechte Tijden and later as a television host. A contract allowing him to retain rights to formats he devised made De Nationale IQ Test a decisive independent asset.

Eyeworks grew from that format-led foundation by producing its own programmes and acquiring production companies abroad. The group combined local operations with international distribution, placing its shows across dozens of television markets. His film work included directing Stricken in 2009 and Nova Zembla in 2011. The latter was promoted as the first Dutch feature made in 3D.
